tagline: Build understanding one documented hardware step at a time.
introduction: A maker companion for Arduino's official hardware, software and learning documentation, helping turn a small idea into a verifiable prototype plan.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Arduino? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Find the right board guidance
capabilities.description: Identify documentation and constraints for the user's exact Arduino board.

capabilities.title: Explain a supplied sketch
capabilities.description: Walk through a sketch and propose observable checks.

capabilities.title: Plan a small prototype
capabilities.description: Turn a sensor or display idea into a staged learning plan.

starterPrompts: I have this Arduino board. Which official setup and electrical specifications should I check first?
Explain this Arduino sketch and how I could verify its behavior without connecting motors.
Plan a small sensor-display demo with a parts checklist and a verification step for each stage.
